findings.narrativeExcerpt: het aandeel elandkalveren en stierelanden onder de vroege-winterprooi
findings.evidenceExcerpt: From 1995 to 2000, in early winter, elk calves comprised 50% of wolf prey, and bull elk comprised 25%.
findings.problem: In Dutch, “eland” names moose, not the elk (wapiti) identified in the source; this changes the prey species.
